name: 100 Days At Sea
desc:
Inspired by 99 Nights in The Forest created by Grandma's Favorite Games

🏴‍☠️ You are sent on a mission to the middle of the ocean.
🏴‍☠️ You must uncover the mystery of the Bermuda Triangle...
✅ Survive 100 Days and get rich!

Open-World Survival game where exploration and base building is the key to survival.

HOW TO PLAY:
🔩 Grab resources or hook them with your Harpoon.
🔨 Build your raft base with structures and defenses.
🗺️ Explore the sea and visit mysterious islands.
⚔️ Find weapons and take on fearsome foes!
